name: Seru Noble Terrace
description: The Noble Terrace houses Sanctus Seru’s elite: Praetorian commanders, magistrates, inquisitors, and high-ranking doctrinal officials. Purity-screened estates, ceremonial courtyards, arcane-lit terraces, and Praetorian honor patrols define this district. Every residence is fortified, monitored, and aligned with the Tribunal’s doctrine.
